mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN in_quantity > 0 THEN in_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN out_quantity > 0 THEN out_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available_stock FROM stockinout_data WHERE REPLACE(product_name, '&', '&') = REPLACE(#{productName}, '&', '&') AND ROUND(price, 2) = ROUND(#{price}, 2) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (target_system IS NULL OR target_system != 'SOT')

mapper.select: SELECT remark_number, SUM(in_quantity) AS total_in, SUM(out_quantity) AS total_out FROM stockinout_data WHERE remark_number LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '-%') AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY remark_number
